from delta.tables import DeltaTable
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

TABLE_PATH = "abfss://workinstruction@navispowerbidatastorage2.dfs.core.windows.net/silver_xps"
PARTITION_COLUMN = "client_id"
PARTITION_VALUE = "GPA"

# Replace this with the last known-good Delta table version for GPA
GOOD_VERSION = 173

PARTITION_PREDICATE = f"{PARTITION_COLUMN} = '{PARTITION_VALUE}'"

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Display recent table history
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

delta_table = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, TABLE_PATH)

history_df = (
    delta_table.history()
    .select(
        "version",
        "timestamp",
        "operation",
        "operationParameters",
        "operationMetrics",
        "userName"
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("version").desc())
)

display(history_df)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Read GPA from the previous good table version
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

gpa_previous = (
    spark.read
    .format("delta")
    .option("versionAsOf", GOOD_VERSION)
    .load(TABLE_PATH)
    .where(F.col(PARTITION_COLUMN) == PARTITION_VALUE)
)

print(f"GPA rows at version {GOOD_VERSION}: {gpa_previous.count()}")

display(
    gpa_previous
    .orderBy(F.col("load_timestamp").desc_nulls_last())
    .limit(50)
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Validate that the historical version actually contains GPA
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

gpa_versions = (
    spark.read
    .format("delta")
    .option("versionAsOf", GOOD_VERSION)
    .load(TABLE_PATH)
    .where(F.col(PARTITION_COLUMN) == PARTITION_VALUE)
    .select(PARTITION_COLUMN)
    .distinct()
    .collect()
)

if len(gpa_versions) == 0:
    raise ValueError(
        f"No rows found for {PARTITION_PREDICATE} at Delta version {GOOD_VERSION}"
    )

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Optional: record current counts for all partitions
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

before_counts = (
    spark.read
    .format("delta")
    .load(TABLE_PATH)
    .groupBy(PARTITION_COLUMN)
    .count()
    .orderBy(PARTITION_COLUMN)
)

print("Partition counts before restore:")
display(before_counts)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Restore only the GPA partition
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# replaceWhere prevents rows outside GPA from being overwritten.

(
    gpa_previous.write
    .format("delta")
    .mode("overwrite")
    .option("replaceWhere", PARTITION_PREDICATE)
    .save(TABLE_PATH)
)

print(f"Restored only {PARTITION_PREDICATE} from Delta version {GOOD_VERSION}")

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Validate the result
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

after_counts = (
    spark.read
    .format("delta")
    .load(TABLE_PATH)
    .groupBy(PARTITION_COLUMN)
    .count()
    .orderBy(PARTITION_COLUMN)
)

print("Partition counts after restore:")
display(after_counts)

current_gpa = (
    spark.read
    .format("delta")
    .load(TABLE_PATH)
    .where(F.col(PARTITION_COLUMN) == PARTITION_VALUE)
)

print("Current GPA data after restore:")
display(current_gpa)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Check the new Delta commit
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

display(
    delta_table.history(1).select(
        "version",
        "timestamp",
        "operation",
        "operationParameters",
        "operationMetrics"
    )
)
